title: Report process environment
responsibility: Combines report settings with explicit environment overrides for report configuration and Cloudflare context.

outputs.name: reportsEnvironment
outputs.description: A new object copied from process.env in which PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE and PROJECT_REPORTS_CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_HOME take the settings-file value only when the variable is undefined (an empty string still counts as set). Settings come from HARNESS_REPORTS_SETTINGS_FILE when that is set, otherwise from <os.homedir()>/.codex/harness/report-settings.json; a missing file (ENOENT) yields no settings, a report key that neither source sets is still present with value undefined, and parsed values are copied without type checks.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Invalid Harness report settings file.' when the settings file read fails with anything other than an ENOENT error, or when its content is not valid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown as a TypeError when the settings file contains the JSON value null and PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE or PROJECT_REPORTS_CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_HOME is undefined in process.env; that property read happens outside the try block, so it is not the Invalid Harness report settings file Error.
